purpose: Bounded Top-1 quality diagnosis; no new abstraction experiments
train_maps: Exactly the original first 40 pilot training maps (4736 transitions)
validation: The original 20 held-out pilot validation maps (2404 transitions)
secondary_validation: Three rotations of those same validation maps; diagnostic only, excluded from selection
stress: All 24 existing stress maps (2976 transitions); already inspected, excluded from training and selection
untouched_test: The 50 pilot test maps are neither trained on nor scored in this round
checkpoint_rule: Only epoch 300 is eligible; intermediate original-validation scores diagnose convergence, not checkpoint selection
optimizer_restart: Baselines contain no AdamW/RNG state. Continuations explicitly restart AdamW and loader generator at epoch 100. Capacity control uses the same restart at epoch 100.
schedule: Constant through epoch 100; cosine from the stated learning_rate at epoch 101 to final_learning_rate at epoch 300 (constant when endpoints equal)
selection: Include baseline; maximize mean original-validation Top-1 accuracy across all three seeds; ties prefer fewer trainable parameters, then listed order. Select one configuration for every seed.
clear_validation_improvement: At least 1 percentage point in three-seed mean and strictly better on every seed
99_percent_goal: Report whether every seed reaches 99% on validation and separately on stress; 100% means zero errors on the full enumerated split
stop: Stop after these three configurations regardless of results; no extra epochs, configurations, decoder search or stress-directed tuning
behavior: Same greatest simulation/bisimulation algorithms and independent audits, six native CTL properties, six nuXmv LTL properties; also reuse strict nuXmv CTL/paired-formula sanity checker
preservation: Original weights, source learning/verification/evaluation modules and all previous output files remain byte-identical; new outputs/top1_quality/round1 only
